title: Noel 2015 walking full-body action PPS
citation: Noel, J. P., Grivaz, P., Marmaroli, P., Lissek, H., Blanke, O., & Serino, A. (2015). Full body action remapping of peripersonal space: the case of walking. Neuropsychologia, 70, 375-384.
notes: Paper-extracted standing/walking full-body PPS profile. The runnable toolkit profile captures the reported white-noise source, 2 m approach/recede path, 0.75 m/s velocity, chest vibrotactile target, tactile delay/distance table, 512-trial experiment count, and mouse-click proxy for the right-thumb button response. The original treadmill, optic-flow display, physical two-array loudspeaker interpolation, and motor calibration remain apparatus context rather than generated stimuli.

reference_parameters.reported_experiments: Experiment 1 standing versus treadmill walking; Experiment 2 standing versus walking with optic-flow-only manipulation.
reference_parameters.reported_loudspeaker_setup: Two uniform linear arrays of eight JBL Control 1 Pro loudspeakers each, positioned 50 cm laterally from the participant and extending 2 m in front of the chest.
reference_parameters.optic_flow_experiment_2_context: 40 dots/m^2 on a 4.0 x 2.5 m screen at 1280 x 1024 and 60 Hz, producing forward vection around 78 cm/s.
reference_parameters.reported_tactile_stimulus: 100 ms chest vibration from Precision MicroDrives shaftless vibration motors, model 312-101, 3 V, 60 mA, 9000 rpm, 150 Hz, 5 g.
reference_parameters.reported_response_rule: Right-thumb button press on a wireless Xbox 360 controller as fast as possible to the chest vibration; ignore sound-only catch trials.
reference_parameters.reported_trial_formula: 2 Locomotion conditions x 2 Sound directions x (5 Sound distances + 2 Baselines + 1 Catch) x 16 repetitions = 512 trials per subject.
reference_parameters.expected_scientific_outcome: Standing facilitation is reported close to the body, around D1-D2; walking expands facilitation through D5, around 166 cm. Receding sounds do not show the same space-dependent modulation, and optic flow alone does not explain the walking expansion.
reference_parameters.minimum_runnable_profile_scope: Audio-tactile PPS task rows and run artifacts for the standing/walking x looming/receding design. Locomotion and optic-flow context are preserved as row metadata.
nonblocking_caveats: exact original white-noise waveform/seed not supplied, represented by procedural white noise
physical dual eight-speaker-array interpolation and room acoustics are represented by the toolkit's reference spatial renderer
treadmill and optic-flow manipulations are preserved as condition metadata and are not generated by the audio-tactile runner
exact vibrotactile motor onset calibration and controller latency correction are not reported
paper text labels distances in cm; values are interpreted as 33, 66, 100, 133, and 166 cm from the reported 0.75 m/s velocity and timing table

provenance.source: Methods report white noise at 50 dB, two arrays of eight loudspeakers, 2 m approach/recede path, and 75 cm/s sound velocity.
Methods report 100 ms chest vibration from Precision MicroDrives model 312-101 motors and right-thumb wireless Xbox 360 controller responses.
Methods report tactile delays T1-T5 = 0.44, 0.88, 1.33, 1.77, and 2.22 s, with receding T1-T5 mapped D1-D5 and looming T1-T5 mapped D5-D1.
Methods report 2 Locomotion x 2 Sound Direction x (5 Distances + 2 Baselines + 1 Catch) x 16 = 512 trials.
Results report standing near-body facilitation around D1-D2 and walking facilitation through D5/166 cm, with receding sounds not showing the same spatial modulation.
